class.name: NNBTDecoratorNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree decorator nodes.
class.description: A decorator node wraps a single behaviour tree child and changes how or when that child is ticked. A decorator must have exactly one enabled behaviour tree child. It ticks the first enabled child, so any further enabled behaviour tree children are ignored. The first time a decorator is ticked with more than one enabled behaviour tree child it reports a one-time error. The editor shows a configuration warning for the same configuration. If no behaviour tree child is enabled, the decorator keeps its existing fall-through result instead of reporting an error.
